_comment: Each entry is a function-calling tool definition sent to the LLM. 'dispatch' tells the Android app HOW to execute it: 'intent' = native Android Intent (fast, reliable), 'tasker' = fires a Tasker task by name (use for anything without a public API, or UI automation).

tools.name: set_reminder
tools.description: Create a reminder/alarm for the user at a specific time

message.description: What to remind the user about

time.description: ISO 8601 datetime or relative time like 'in 30 minutes'

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Save a quick note for the user

tools.name: open_app
tools.description: Open a specific app by name

tools.name: search_in_app
tools.description: Open an app and perform a search inside it (requires Tasker + AutoInput since most apps have no public search intent)

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a text/WhatsApp message to a contact

tools.name: read_notifications
tools.description: Read back the user's recent notifications, optionally filtered by app

app_filter.description: Optional app name to filter by

tools.name: add_calendar_event
tools.description: Add an event to the user's calendar

tools.name: answer_only
tools.description: No device action needed — just answer the user's question conversationally
